name: npp_flood_down
desc: Real npp PBA distance-transform kernel kernelFloodDown(short2* input, short2* output, int size, int bandSize) from libnpp sm_90 npp.cubin, lifted to x86 and run on CPU. Phase-1 'flood down': each thread owns one column tx and walks bandSize rows downward within its band (ty=blockIdx.y*bandSize), carrying the last seen non-empty site (pixel.x != MARKER, MARKER=-32768=0x8000) downward into output[id]. short2 packs a 2D site coord (.x low16, .y high16). Pure function of input, each column independent and writing only its own column rows -> ORDER-INDEPENDENT. Params: input@0x210, output@0x218, size@0x220, bandSize@0x224; desc base 0. 2D launch (reads SR_CTAID.Y).
ground_truth: x86-lifted vs independent host flood-down reference on scattered sites + MARKER sentinels: 0/1024 mismatches, TEST PASSED
